_comment: Per-variant one-liner that gets injected into the prompt for each tile. Names match assets/tiles/stage{N}-{name}/{variant}.png exactly. F2.5-continuation: variants that were flagged in the user visual review now carry an explicit negative_prompt to enforce terrain-fidelity and ASSET-005 anti-glorification (vertedero).

stage1-bosque.pino_clear_grass_rojizo: Mediterranean pine clearing on reddish clay soil, sparse pine needles, low tufts of dry grass

pino_underbrush_dark.note: Dark forest underbrush zone under pine canopy, dark soil in deep shadow, dry fallen pine needles and twigs scattered on the ground
pino_underbrush_dark.negative_prompt: no moss carpet, no green moss, no lush green undergrowth, no ferns, no grass tufts; only dark brown shadowed soil with dry pine needles and twigs

stage1-bosque.encina_redonda_sombra: Round holm oak (encina) shadow on reddish soil, dry leaf litter around the canopy projection
stage1-bosque.suelo_arcilloso_rojizo: Bare reddish clay soil between trees, dry and cracked, no vegetation
stage1-bosque.trocha_forestal_compactada: Forest track compacted by occasional tractors, dirt and pine-needle mix, light ruts
stage1-bosque.matorral_coscoja_romero: Mediterranean scrub patch with coscoja (kermes oak) and romero (rosemary) bushes
stage1-bosque.arroyo_barranco_edge: Edge of a seasonal arroyo (ravine), damp sand + small stones + grass tufts
stage1-bosque.hojarasca_pino_seca: Dry pine needle leaf litter covering the ground, orange-brown, scattered pine cones

stage2-pueblo.cal_blanca_pared: White lime-washed wall base (cal blanca) of a Cofrentes village house, plaster texture
stage2-pueblo.teja_arabe_roja: Red Arabic roof tiles (teja arabe), terracotta, slight weathering
stage2-pueblo.adoquin_calle_empedrada: Cobblestone paving of the narrow calle principal, irregular stones, dry
stage2-pueblo.asfalto_N330_circulado: N-330 asphalt road segment, with painted road markings (circulado / paso)
stage2-pueblo.acera_baldosa_hidraulica: Hydraulic-tile sidewalk (baldosa hidraulica), geometric pattern, worn
stage2-pueblo.sombra_calle_estrecha: Deep shadow cast by adjacent buildings on a narrow calle, light blue-grey
stage2-pueblo.balcon_hierro_forjado: Wrought-iron balcony (balcon de hierro forjado) with simple geometric railing
stage2-pueblo.porton_madera_pueblo: Heavy wooden village gate (porton de madera), aged planks, iron studs

stage3-rio.agua_cristalina_verde_azul: Crystal-clear river water with green-blue tint, shallow ripples over pebbles
stage3-rio.cortado_vertical_karstico: Vertical karst cliff face (cortado vertical), light limestone, fractured

roca_chorrera_humeda.note: Bare wet rock face of a chorrera (waterfall cascade) on dark karst stone, glistening wet sheen, water streaks running down the rock, NO vegetation at all
roca_chorrera_humeda.negative_prompt: no moss, no lichen, no green plants, no grass, no shrubs, no ferns, no vegetation of any kind; only bare wet dark rock with water sheen and mineral streaks

stage3-rio.sedimento_aluvial_rio: Alluvial sediment on the river bank, fine gravel + silt + driftwood traces
stage3-rio.chopo_ribera_densa: Dense riparian poplar (chopo) grove, dappled shade on the ground
stage3-rio.canto_rodado_orilla: Rounded pebbles (cantos rodados) on the river edge, mixed grey and ochre
stage3-rio.musgo_humedo_roca: Damp moss growing on a river rock, vivid green against wet stone
stage3-rio.ladera_matorral_seca: Dry scrubby slope above the river, matorral mediterraneo, sun-bleached

cement_pad_crack.note: Pure cracked grey concrete industrial pad, dirty grey, rust and oil stains, rebar poking through cracks, NO vegetation at all
cement_pad_crack.negative_prompt: no green moss, no plants, no grass, no weeds, no vegetation of any kind; only pure cracked grey concrete with rust and oil stains

stage4-vertedero.gravel_dust_industrial: Industrial gravel and dust, compacted, truck tire tracks, no grass
stage4-vertedero.dirt_oily_contaminated: Oily contaminated dirt, dark brown-black, iridescent patches, no life

plastic_debris_mixed.note: Mixed shredded plastic debris pile, dirty dull grey-brown bags and packaging fragments, no living vegetation at all, weathered and stained, ugly industrial trash
plastic_debris_mixed.negative_prompt: no living vegetation, no grass, no plants, no green moss, no trees, no natural beauty; only dirty shredded plastic bags and packaging debris in dull grey-brown tones, industrial trash pile

stage4-vertedero.container_lixiviado_stain: Container stained by leachate (lixiviado) runoff, dark crust, rust streaks
stage4-vertedero.metal_scrap_rust: Rusty metal scrap heap, brown-orange oxidation, no shine, no green
stage4-vertedero.asphalt_cracked_heavy_truck: Heavy-truck-cracked asphalt, deep fissures, oil drips, industrial weight

weeds_through_pavement.note: Sparse dead and dying weeds forcing through cracked industrial pavement, dry grey-brown struggling stalks, almost no green left, depressed struggling life
weeds_through_pavement.negative_prompt: no lush green weeds, no healthy green foliage, no flowers; only sparse dry grey-brown dying weed stalks pushing through cracked pavement, minimal colour, oppressive industrial mood

stage5-castillo.penon_basalto_volcanico: Volcanic basalt rock of the Cerro de Agras penon, dark brown-red, rugged
stage5-castillo.cal_castillo_blanca: White lime (cal) wall of the Castillo de Cofrentes, bright sun-bleached
stage5-castillo.torre_homenaje_reloj: Torre del Homenaje base with clock tower projection, masonry blocks
stage5-castillo.mamposteria_antigua_ocre: Ancient ochre masonry, weathered stonework, irregular blocks
stage5-castillo.patio_armas_adoquines: Patio de Armas paved with adoquines (cobblestones), worn by centuries

sendero_subida_penon.note: Bare dirt and stone footpath climbing up the dark volcanic basalt penon, low stone steps carved into the rock, NO forest or trees lining the path
sendero_subida_penon.negative_prompt: no trees lining the path, no forest, no lush green vegetation, no dense pines; only bare dirt and stone steps climbing dark volcanic basalt rock with minimal scrub

pino_penon_mediterraneo.note: Sparse individual Mediterranean pine trees growing directly out of dark volcanic basalt rock on the penon, large gaps of bare rock between trees, very low density
pino_penon_mediterraneo.negative_prompt: no dense pine forest, no continuous canopy, no closed tree cover; only sparse scattered individual pines with large bare volcanic rock gaps between them

stage5-castillo.aljibe_boveda_subterraneo: Underground aljibe (cistern) vaulted ceiling hint, masonry ribs, dim
